verdict.rationale: cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes the entire codebase and produces searchable wikis with architecture diagrams and source links, and codebase scans deploy AI agents across the whole repo — both let a developer get a full-codebase map/explanation without hand-picking context files. However, this is documented only in first-party docs with no independent hands-on validation of how well it 'explains' an unfamiliar codebase, and community commentary focuses on PR-review quality rather than the wiki/codebase-scan features. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the AI wiki's accuracy and usefulness, and community evidence specifically evaluating whole-codebase explanation quality.
